question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹ 1,200 at an interest rate of 3% per month for 12 months.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total interest rate for 12 months = 3% × 12 = 36%

Simple Interest = 36% of Principal

SI = 36% of 1200

SI = 36 × 12 = 432

**∴ The correct answer is ₹ 432.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹ 1,200

Rate of Interest (R) = 3% per month

Time (T) = 12 months
